infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Aparaitech uses your camera during an authorized interview after you consent.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Aparaitech uses your microphone to capture your interview response after you consent.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Speech recognition converts your interview response into a transcript for review.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Aparaitech to use your camera for this interview.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Aparaitech to use your microphone for this interview.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Aparaitech to select a photo of your resume for secure AI extraction.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Aparaitech to photograph your resume for secure AI extraction.
